paragraphs: Bloomerang Volunteer is volunteer management software for nonprofits, covering recruiting, scheduling, engagement, tracking and reporting. It is aimed at organizations of any size, including those with large volunteer bases, recurring shifts and multiple sites or programs.

Scheduling filters volunteers by skills, roles, availability and interests to match them to open shifts. Volunteers use a mobile app to manage schedules, stay informed and check in on site. Background checks run inside the platform against an organization's own safety and compliance standards. Reporting turns volunteer hours into custom reports showing dollars saved through volunteer work. Because donors, volunteers and fundraising sit on one platform, volunteer data can be used to identify donor prospects.

The volunteer product arrived by acquisition, and the company milestone list records that Bloomerang acquired InitLive and launched Bloomerang Volunteer Management. Bloomerang presents itself as a unified giving platform built for purpose. The same page claims over ten years of purpose-built software. Other milestones include acquiring Qgiv to expand the giving platform.
